item.title: Wi-Fi Sniffing
item.description:
The DevKitty hardware can sniff Wi-Fi packets, allowing hackers to hunt for particular Wi-Fi devices or write packet filters to display deauthentication packets.

To get started, you’ll need to install CircuitPython on your DevKitty.

item.title: SSDP Phishing
item.description:
DevKitty can be flashed to act as a SSDP (Simple Service Discovery Protocol) device, connecting to a Wi-Fi network appearing to nearby Windows users as a network-attached drive.

This attack can be used to redirect users to phishing pages when they click on the drive. We created a demo you can find here
